topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class to the final lecture and introduces the learning objectives regarding cancer therapies and their modes of action.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies: Surgery, Radiotherapy, and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss traditional modalities of cancer treatment—including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic drugs—along with their mechanisms, systemic toxicities, and drug resistance mechanisms.

topics.label: Exploiting Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities, Checkpoint Defects, and DNA Repair Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how therapies exploit specific cancer cell vulnerabilities, including hormone receptor dependencies, cell cycle checkpoint losses, and defective DNA repair pathways through synthetic lethality.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction, Kinase Inhibitors, and Mechanisms of Drug Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the targeting of driver oncogenes with small-molecule kinase inhibitors and analyse the structural and pathway-level mechanisms through which tumors develop resistance and drug addiction.

topics.label: Therapeutic Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the engineering and application of monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates to selectively target cancer cell surface antigens and deliver cytotoxic agents.

topics.label: Immune Surveillance, Checkpoint Blockade, and T-Cell-Directed Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the role of the immune system in cancer control and review therapeutic approaches to stimulate or engineer T cells, including checkpoint inhibitors, BiTEs, and CAR T cells.

topics.label: Overarching Challenges, Historical Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review systemic challenges in oncology, historical improvements in survival and prevention, emerging therapeutic paradigms, and the ethical dilemmas of treatment selection.
